name: Loading keeps the file text byte for byte (Suunto export)

window.__T = { wait: (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)),
  bytes: async (path) => new Uint8Array(await (await fetch(location.origin + '/' + path)).arrayBuffer()),
  eq: (a, b) => a.length === b.length && a.every((x, i) => x === b[i]),
  diff: (a, b) => { let i = 0; while (i < a.length && a[i] === b[i]) i++; let j = 0; while (j < a.length - i && j < b.length - i && a[a.length-1-j] === b[b.length-1-j]) j++; return [a.slice(i, a.length - j), b.slice(i, b.length - j)]; } };await openFromUrl(location.origin + '/samples/example_from_suunto.gpx'); window.__o = gpx.text; return { exact: __T.eq(new TextEncoder().encode(gpx.text), await __T.bytes('samples/example_from_suunto.gpx')), editable: gpx.editable, wpts: wptItems.length }
